cards.title: Pest Awareness
cards.body:
By the end of this session you can:
- spot the warning signs of pests
- deny pests food, water and shelter
- report straight away

cards.title: More than unpleasant
cards.body: Pests such as rodents, insects and birds are not just unpleasant. They spread disease, contaminate food, and can get a business closed down by environmental health. The best defence is prevention and early action.

items.title: Closure
items.text: Environmental health can close a business.

cards.title: Catch it early
cards.body: Learn the warning signs so you can catch a problem early. Spotting them before an infestation takes hold makes them far easier and cheaper to deal with.

cards.title: Deny food, water and shelter
cards.body: Prevention comes down to denying pests the three things they need.

items.title: Food
items.text: Store food covered and off the floor. Clear debris and waste promptly, especially overnight.

items.title: Water
items.text: Do not leave standing water around.

items.title: Shelter
items.text: Seal gaps and holes where you can.

cards.title: Keep them out
cards.body: Keep bin areas clean with lids closed. Keep external doors and windows closed or screened.

left.title: Do
items: Close or screen doors and windows

cards.title: Quick and honest
cards.body: If you see any sign of pests, or an actual pest, report it to a manager straight away. Do not keep quiet hoping it will go away, and do not try to tackle a serious problem yourself. We use professional pest control for that.

items.title: Spot it
items.text: Any sign, or an actual pest.

cards.title: Remember
cards.body:
- Learn the signs: droppings, gnaw marks, smears, nests, dead insects, musty smell
- Deny pests food, water and shelter
- Food covered and off the floor, bin lids closed, doors not propped
- Report any sign to a manager straight away
- Serious problems go to professional pest control

cards.q: Which of these is a warning sign of pests?
cards.why: Warning signs include droppings, gnaw marks, greasy smear marks, nesting material, dead insects and a musty smell.

cards.q: Pests can spread disease and get a business closed down.
cards.why: Pests spread disease, contaminate food, and can get a business closed down by environmental health.

cards.q: Pests need three things: food, water and…
cards.why: Prevention is about denying pests food, water and shelter.

cards.q: Food should be stored covered and off the floor.
cards.why: Store all food covered and off the floor to deny pests food.

cards.q: If you see a sign of pests you should…
options: Clean it quietly and say nothing at all
Report it to a manager straight away
Ignore it and hope it goes away
Put down traps yourself that evening
cards.why: Report any sign straight away. Do not keep quiet and hope it goes away.

cards.q: External doors should be propped open to keep the kitchen cool.
cards.why: Keep external doors and windows closed or screened to keep pests out.

cards.q: Why is food debris left out overnight a problem?
options: It attracts pests by giving them food
It spoils the morning cleaning rota
It uses up the bin liners
cards.why: Clearing food debris and waste promptly, especially overnight, denies pests the food they need.

cards.q: Catching a pest problem early makes it easier and cheaper to deal with.
cards.why: Spotting signs early, before an infestation takes hold, makes them far easier and cheaper to deal with.

cards.q: A serious pest problem should be dealt with by…
cards.why: Do not try to tackle a serious problem yourself. We use professional pest control for that.

cards.q: Bin areas should be kept clean with lids closed.
cards.why: Keep bin areas clean with lids closed so pests have no food and no way in.
